guard: both cotal down policy branches signal a live pre-pin manager after the documented legacy warning, bare down never reports a historical destructive handler's reaped agent as spared, and pinned manager policy remains identity-bound
why: A manager launched before identity pins existed, or on a platform whose injected start-token reader returns undefined, has no token for the full identity-pinned handoff. The documented upgrade contract still signals that live record after warning. Bare down cannot verify which SIGTERM handler the running binary carries, so it prints only uncertainty and never reports the pre-signal inventory as confirmed spared; --with-agents publishes the reduced-guarantee pid-and-reservation-inode handoff so an intent-aware manager selects destructive teardown.

The mutations restore each tokenless refusal that shipped at the blocked head plus its false affirmative spare report. The smoke plants real unpinned manager records and drives both real down policy branches. Its historical handler actually kills a real child on SIGTERM and the named cell rejects every confirmed-spared rendering. The same public suite observes pinned mismatch refusal, while bin/smoke/mutations/pid-identity.json remains its dedicated mechanical guard.

mutations.name: M1 restore the unconditional legacy-manager refusal before SIGTERM
mutations.expectRed: a legacy unpinned manager reaches SIGTERM on bare down and its pidfile is removed
mutations.cell: a legacy unpinned manager reaches SIGTERM on bare down and its pidfile is removed
mutations.note: Restores the blocked-head behavior exactly: both live legacy records stop before SIGTERM, remain alive, and keep their pidfiles. The suite executes bare and --with-agents first, then the named bare cell is the first red.

mutations.name: M2 restore the tokenless destructive-intent refusal
mutations.replace:
if (attempt.target.token === undefined)
    throw new Error("cannot arm --with-agents: manager process identity is not pinned; destructive policy was not published");
mutations.expectRed: a legacy unpinned manager reaches SIGTERM on --with-agents and its pidfile is removed
mutations.cell: a legacy unpinned manager reaches SIGTERM on --with-agents and its pidfile is removed
mutations.note: Restores the stale helper throw. The public --with-agents branch still calls the helper, so the live legacy manager is not signalled and its pidfile remains, reddening the destructive-path cell.

mutations.name: M3 report a tokenless manager's pre-signal inventory as confirmed spared
mutations.expectRed: bare down never reports a historical destructive manager's reaped agent as spared
mutations.cell: bare down never reports a historical destructive manager's reaped agent as spared
mutations.note: Restores the false affirmative output from the blocked head. The fixture's historical SIGTERM handler actually kills its agent, so rendering even an empty confirmed-spared inventory is a named red rather than a prose-only check.
